snapshot.title: ENDEX: System Restored — Full Recovery

fields.resolution: ENDEX. The system has been restored from a clean backup. All 17 corrupted calls have been reconciled via radio logs, run cards, and a 24-hour audit. The verification plan is closed, and the system is fully operational. The Director has authorized full return to digital operations. The hot wash begins.
finalState: All 911 systems are back online and synchronized with field reports.
CAD-MDS01, CAD-DB01, and CAD-APP01 are restored from the 2025-12-31 23:59 clean backup.
The TDoS-strict rule set remains active on all 10-digit lines.
Tamarack County Communications has ceased rerouting — calls are now being handled directly by RCECD.
The public has been notified via press release and social media that 911 is now fully functional.
